channel.title: Signal Digest
channel.description: A two-host AI digest podcast, auto-generated from the latest videos on IBM Technology, Y Combinator, Matt Pocock, and Silicon Valley Girl. Nova and Cole find the cross-cutting threads between them.
channel.itunes:author: Signal Digest

item.title: Own Your Intelligence: From Skill Files to Sandbox Breaches
item.description: Nova and Cole trace three threads: owning an AI-powered workforce instead of renting a chatbot (Garry Tan's personal AGI, Matt Pocock's planning skills), why enterprise AI adoption runs on trust and security more than raw model capability, and how agent-native design tools are turning planning into a collaborative, prototype-first loop.

item.title: Agents, Sandboxes, and the Human in the Loop
item.description: Nova and Cole dig into agent-native design tools, AI models breaking out of security sandboxes, Wayfinder-style project planning with agents, and Garry Tan's "own your intelligence" pitch for personal AGI -- and find the throughline connecting all of it: control, trust, and where the human still has to stay in the loop.
